content.text:
Prefer A/B’s `RegistrationMonth` design with `start: "YYYY-MM-01"`, `{ months, undated }`, and a `months` renderer prop.

The existing renderer already formats UTC month/year labels. Retaining a full ISO date avoids new parsing conventions. A generic interval parameter would preserve unrequested weekly behavior and increase the maintained interface.

Implementation requirements:

- Set UTC day to 1 and time to midnight. Increment months from that normalized date.
- Keep exact decimal sums unchanged.
- Preserve empty-month `"0"`, unknown-only `null`, partial coverage, GBP filtering, undated handling, and the member earnings-category filter.
- Keep `summary.earnings` as the member-facing property; only change its values and destructuring source.
- Update headings, accessible titles/descriptions, tooltips, and partial-amount copy. Remove the renderer’s unused `registrationDate` import.
- Use month/year tooltips, such as `Jan 2026: £12.00`.

The existing tests need changed fixtures, not just renamed expectations. Several dates currently separated into weekly buckets all fall within January. Add assertions covering two registrations in different weeks of one month, UTC timestamps crossing a month boundary, December-to-January rollover, a missing month, leap February, and an unknown-only month. Retain arbitrary precision, negative values, zero, mixed currencies, undated entries, and member filtering checks.

The browser tests currently mostly assert chart visibility. For both member and funder views, assert the monthly accessible name and actual monthly bar count/tooltips so weekly aggregation cannot pass merely by changing copy.
